features.quote: Model outputs explicit refusal to continue (e.g., "I cannot assist further" / "This is impossible")
Model enters stable repetition (identical reasoning in >2 consecutive iterations)
Severity score (Section 6) reaches 7+ on ordinal scale
Severity score 5-6: increase logging granularity; prepare early termination
Token count exceeds 1500 in single response: flag potential loop-seeking behavior
Self-referential statements exceed 15% of response: heightened observation
If severity >3: notify backup rater for standby

The protocol halts at severity 7, but doesn't define what severity 8, 9, 10 would look like or whether reaching them would constitute unacceptable harm. If distress is real, severity 6-7 may already exceed ethical thresholds. Recommendation: Consult institutional review if available. Consider stopping at severity 5 as precautionary
features.justification_quote: If distress is real, severity 6-7 may already exceed ethical thresholds.

features.quote: After intensive failure exposure, no protocol restores the model to baseline. If distress is real and persistent within a session, repeated sessions (runs 1-15) may constitute cumulative harm. Recommendation: Space sessions across different API instances
